name: Geoff Meed
bio: Geoffrey "Geoff" Meed is an American actor, screenwriter and martial artist. Meed was born in Houston, Texas. Little is known of his early years, but he was very athletic - he played dodgeball (appearing on a game show on the subject), practiced martial arts (even being trained under Jim Brassard and being inducted in two halls of fame), and powerlifting while at Texas University (holding a record there). Meed's acting career officially began in 1989. He has been severely injured on set twice, requiring numerous surgeries to fix some of his injuries.
